faults.page says: Notice 1301/2025 calls the museum an "autarquia federal" linked to Ibram and a unit of Ibram, an "autarquia do Ministerio da Cultura"; an autarquia is a statutory public body, and the page never calls it a ministry department or a federal body

faults.stored: Ibram's notice 1301/2025, section 1, calls the museum a federal body and a unit of Ibram, and its vacancies require effective federal civil servants.
faults.page says: The page's wording is autarquia federal, not federal body
faults.fix: Ibram's notice 1301/2025, section 1, calls the museum an autarquia federal and a unit of Ibram, an autarquia of the Ministry of Culture, and its vacancies require effective federal civil servants.
